lines.zh: 我身子贴着地，一路小跑过去。
lines.en: I keep my body low and trot along the ground.

lines.zh: 草比我高，我只有尾巴露在外面。
lines.en: The grass is taller than me; only my tail shows.

lines.zh: 跑起来脊背一拱一拱，像根弹簧。
lines.en: Running, my back arches and arches like a spring.

lines.zh: 这条田埂我熟，下面是兔子洞。
lines.en: I know this ridge; rabbit burrows run beneath it.

lines.zh: 我钻过篱笆的缝，一点声音都没有。
lines.en: I slip through a gap in the fence without a sound.

lines.zh: 泥土软，我四个爪子陷进去半寸。
lines.en: The soil is soft; my paws sink half an inch.

lines.zh: 走三步停一下，先听草丛里有没有动静。
lines.en: Three steps, then a pause to listen in the grass.

lines.zh: 我从倒木底下穿过去，毛上沾了苔。
lines.en: I pass under a fallen log and pick up moss.

lines.zh: 尾巴翘着，这样拐弯才不会甩到树上。
lines.en: I keep my tail up so turns do not swing it into trees.

lines.zh: 我不走大路，大路上人太多。
lines.en: I avoid the main road; too many people use it.

lines.zh: 前面有片灌木，我从中间钻。
lines.en: A thicket ahead; I push straight through the middle.

lines.zh: 爪子踩在落叶上，声音被我压住了。
lines.en: My paws press dry leaves, and I muffle the sound.

lines.zh: 跑一段我就回头，看看有没有落下什么。
lines.en: Every so often I look back to check what I left.

lines.zh: 我把自己盘起来，塞进一只旧靴子里。
lines.en: I curl up and tuck myself into an old boot.

lines.zh: 阳光照在肚皮上，是最舒服的角度。
lines.en: Sun on my belly is the most comfortable angle.

lines.zh: 一天里我大半时间在睡。
lines.en: I spend most of the day asleep.

lines.zh: 我站起来，伸个懒腰，又趴回去。
lines.en: I stand, stretch long, and flop back down.

lines.zh: 耳朵转了一下，是外面有鸟叫。
lines.en: One ear turns; a bird is calling outside.

lines.zh: 我把自己塞进树根的空洞里。
lines.en: I wedge myself into a hollow between tree roots.

lines.zh: 身上有股味道，那是我的记号。
lines.en: I carry a musky smell; that is my own mark.

lines.zh: 我舔爪子，把脸上的泥擦掉。
lines.en: I lick my paws and wipe the mud off my face.

lines.zh: 洞口的草被我压成一个圆。
lines.en: The grass at my burrow mouth is pressed into a circle.

lines.zh: 我打个哈欠，露出一嘴小尖牙。
lines.en: I yawn and show a mouthful of small sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖一下一下地敲着地。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the ground, once and again.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，夜里才是我的时候。
lines.en: I wait for dark; the night belongs to me.

lines.zh: 有只甲虫爬过来，我懒得动。
lines.en: A beetle crawls near; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子埋进尾巴里，暖和。
lines.en: I bury my nose in my tail; it is warm there.

lines.zh: 我在草里翻了个身，晒另一侧。
lines.en: I roll over in the grass to warm my other side.

lines.zh: 我从靴子里探出头，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I poke my head from the boot, showing only my eyes.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我的鼻子正好对着你的脸。
lines.en: You crouch, and my nose is level with your face.

lines.zh: 我在闻你，闻你走过哪里。
lines.en: I am smelling you, and where you have been.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里有生兔肉的味道。
lines.en: There is raw rabbit in your pocket; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，另一只耳朵在听别处。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you while one ear listens elsewhere.

lines.zh: 你手放低一点，我就敢靠近。
lines.en: Lower your hand a little and I will dare come close.

lines.zh: 我站起来了，整条身子像一根长毛绳。
lines.en: I stand up, my whole body like a long furry rope.

lines.zh: 你眼睛跟着我，我也不躲。
lines.en: Your eyes follow me, and I do not hide.

lines.zh: 你要是伸手抓，我就先跑三步。
lines.en: If you reach to grab, I run three steps first.

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子，你昨天来过。
lines.en: I know those boots; you came by yesterday.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边绕一圈，把你的味道记住。
lines.en: I circle your feet and memorize your scent.

lines.zh: 你笑得时候，我耳朵往后压了一下。
lines.en: When you smile, my ears press back a little.

lines.zh: 我跳上你的膝盖，只待一小会儿。
lines.en: I hop onto your knee, only for a short while.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就敢在你鞋上磨牙。
lines.en: Stay still and I will chew on your shoe.

lines.zh: 我从洞口探出半个身子看你。
lines.en: I poke half of myself out of the burrow to look at you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声比我的还轻。
lines.en: Your breathing is softer than mine.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子凑到你的指尖上。
lines.en: I push my nose against your fingertip.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我还没看清。
lines.en: I have not worked out what you are holding yet.

lines.zh: 你站得远，我先看你一会儿。
lines.en: You stand far off, so I watch you a while first.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边立起来，够你的手。
lines.en: I rear up at your feet to reach your hand.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴被踩住了，疼得直叫。
lines.en: My tail is pinned; I squeal from the pain.

lines.zh: 别抓我后颈，那里皮很薄。
lines.en: Do not grab my scruff; the skin there is thin.

lines.zh: 我缩进洞里，只留鼻子在外面。
lines.en: I shrink into my burrow, nose barely out.

lines.zh: 这一下让我跳起来半尺高。
lines.en: That blow makes me jump half a foot up.

lines.zh: 我疼得抖，毛全竖起来了。
lines.en: I tremble with pain, my fur all standing up.

lines.zh: 我闻到自己血的味道，很淡。
lines.en: I smell my own blood; it is faint.

lines.zh: 让我钻进草里，我想躲一下。
lines.en: Let me get into the grass; I want to hide.

lines.zh: 我的后腿有点跛，跑不快了。
lines.en: My hind leg limps; I cannot run fast.

lines.zh: 我发出很尖的声音，那是害怕。
lines.en: I make a high thin sound; that is fear.

lines.zh: 缓过来之后，我会离你远点。
lines.en: Once I recover, I will keep my distance.

lines.zh: 生兔肉一拿出来，我的鼻子就抖。
lines.en: The moment raw rabbit appears, my nose twitches.

lines.zh: 你把肉举高，我就用后腿站起来。
lines.en: You raise the meat and I rise on my hind legs.

lines.zh: 给我一小块，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Give me one small piece and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 这块肉还带血，正合适。
lines.en: This meat is still bloody; that is just right.

lines.zh: 我叼住就跑，跑到远处再吃。
lines.en: I snatch it and run off to eat it far away.

lines.zh: 别拽，我会咬住不放。
lines.en: Do not pull; I will clamp down and hold.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，是怕我咬到吗？
lines.en: Your hand is shaking; are you afraid I will bite?

lines.zh: 我闻得出这是兔子后腿，好部位。
lines.en: I can tell this is a rabbit haunch, the good part.

lines.zh: 吃完这块，我大概就认你了。
lines.en: After this piece, I will likely call you mine.

lines.zh: 肉的味道盖过了你身上的铁味。
lines.en: The meat drowns out the iron smell on you.

lines.zh: 我围着你的脚转，等你再给一块。
lines.en: I circle your feet, waiting for another piece.

lines.zh: 生的，不要烤过的，烤的太硬。
lines.en: Raw, not roasted; roasted is too tough.

lines.zh: 我一边吃一边抬头，防着你抢。
lines.en: I eat and glance up, guarding against a grab.

lines.zh: 这块吃完，我就赖着不走了。
lines.en: Once this is gone, I am staying with you.

lines.zh: 你把肉按低，我才肯走近。
lines.en: Lower the meat and only then will I come closer.

lines.zh: 这块太小，我还要一块。
lines.en: That piece is too small; I want another.

lines.zh: 肉味一散，我就忘了怕。
lines.en: As soon as the meat smell spreads, I forget to be afraid.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴了，快抬脚。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 我从你腿间穿过去，蹭了一身毛。
lines.en: I dart between your legs and leave fur on you.

lines.zh: 撞到我，我会立刻翻个身。
lines.en: Bump me and I will roll over at once.

lines.zh: 我太细，你差点没看见我。
lines.en: I am so slender you nearly missed me.

lines.zh: 你的脚挡住洞口，我只好绕。
lines.en: Your foot blocks my burrow; I have to go around.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我打了个滚，没事。
lines.en: That knock sent me rolling; I am fine.

lines.zh: 别用脚拨我，我会当成攻击。
lines.en: Do not nudge me with your foot; I read it as an attack.

lines.zh: 我从你靴子上弹开，落进草里。
lines.en: I bounce off your boot and land in the grass.

lines.zh: 你走得快，我只能小跑跟着。
lines.en: You walk fast, so I must trot to keep up.

lines.zh: 撞完我抖抖毛，把土抖掉。
lines.en: After the bump I shake the dirt from my coat.

lines.zh: 林子里有只母貂，味道很冲。
lines.en: A jill in the woods carries a sharp scent.

lines.zh: 我们绕着圈子跳，谁也不先停。
lines.en: We dance in circles, neither of us stopping first.

lines.zh: 我弓起背，发出咯咯的声音。
lines.en: I arch my back and make a chuckling sound.

lines.zh: 它扑过来，我侧身躲开，再扑回去。
lines.en: It lunges; I dodge aside and lunge back.

lines.zh: 打闹是真的，也是假的。
lines.en: The tussle is real, and it is also play.

lines.zh: 我们钻进同一个树洞，挤在一起。
lines.en: We squeeze into the same tree hollow together.

lines.zh: 它的毛比我的白，尾巴也短些。
lines.en: Its coat is whiter than mine, its tail shorter.

lines.zh: 追了半片林子，它终于慢下来。
lines.en: After half the woods, it finally slows.

lines.zh: 之后它会变得更凶，我得让着点。
lines.en: Afterwards it grows fiercer; I must give ground.

lines.zh: 等小貂出来，我会叼着它们搬家。
lines.en: When the kits come, I will carry them to a new den.

lines.zh: 地上有个亮扣子，我叼起来藏。
lines.en: A shiny button on the ground; I take and hide it.

lines.zh: 我往洞里塞东西，塞得满满的。
lines.en: I stuff things into my burrow until it is full.

lines.zh: 这根羽毛不错，可以垫窝。
lines.en: This feather is good; it will line my nest.

lines.zh: 我叼着比头还大的东西跑。
lines.en: I run carrying something bigger than my own head.

lines.zh: 是块骨头，我要慢慢啃。
lines.en: It is a bone, and I mean to gnaw it slowly.

lines.zh: 掉下来的果子，我推着滚回去。
lines.en: A fallen fruit; I roll it home with my nose.

lines.zh: 我藏东西的地方，从来不告诉别人。
lines.en: Where I hide things, I never tell anyone.

lines.zh: 太重了，我咬住拖了两步。
lines.en: Too heavy; I bite down and drag it two steps.

lines.zh: 这枚戒指会反光，我最喜欢。
lines.en: This ring catches the light; I like it best.

lines.zh: 藏好了，可过两天我自己也找不到。
lines.en: It is hidden, though in two days I will lose it.

lines.zh: 篱笆边有只鸡，我压低身子。
lines.en: A chicken by the fence; I flatten myself low.

lines.zh: 兔子在洞口探头，尾巴一动一动。
lines.en: A rabbit peeks from its burrow, tail twitching.

lines.zh: 这只鸡我盯了很久了。
lines.en: I have had my eye on this chicken a while.

lines.zh: 它低头啄食，正好背对着我。
lines.en: It pecks at the ground with its back to me.

lines.zh: 我鼻子一抽，锁住它的位置。
lines.en: One sniff and I have fixed its position.

lines.zh: 兔子跑得快，可它拐弯慢。
lines.en: The rabbit runs fast but turns poorly.

lines.zh: 我没叫，一叫就全跑了。
lines.en: I stay silent; a sound would scatter them all.

lines.zh: 目标很近，我的后腿已经绷紧。
lines.en: The target is close; my hind legs are already tense.

lines.zh: 那只灰兔比鸡难抓，但肉更多。
lines.en: The grey rabbit is harder than a chicken but meatier.

lines.zh: 我在等它离洞口再远一点。
lines.en: I wait for it to stray further from the burrow.

lines.zh: 它跑，我贴着地追，比它省力。
lines.en: It runs; I chase low, using less effort than it.

lines.zh: 我绕到它前面，截住去路。
lines.en: I cut around in front and block its path.

lines.zh: 它钻进篱笆，我就守在出口。
lines.en: It slips into the fence; I wait at the exit.

lines.zh: 兔子往洞里跑，那里我进不去。
lines.en: The rabbit bolts for its burrow, where I cannot fit.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，前爪先伸出去。
lines.en: I leap, forepaws reaching out ahead of me.

lines.zh: 它转向左边，我跟着压过去。
lines.en: It swerves left; I press in after it.

lines.zh: 鸡飞起来，可飞不了多远。
lines.en: The chicken takes off, but it cannot fly far.

lines.zh: 我把它往空地上赶，那里好下手。
lines.en: I drive it toward open ground, where I have room.

lines.zh: 距离只差半个身子了。
lines.en: The gap is down to half a body length.

lines.zh: 它累了，我的呼吸还很稳。
lines.en: It is tiring; my breathing is still steady.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住它的后颈。
lines.en: I clamp my teeth on the back of its neck.

lines.zh: 前爪按住，牙齿才使得上劲。
lines.en: My forepaws pin it so my teeth can work.

lines.zh: 这一口很快，它来不及叫。
lines.en: This bite is quick; it has no time to cry out.

lines.zh: 我甩了两下头，它就不动了。
lines.en: Two shakes of my head and it goes still.

lines.zh: 鸡毛飞了一地，我打了个喷嚏。
lines.en: Feathers scatter everywhere and I sneeze once.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，直到它彻底安静。
lines.en: I hold on until it is completely quiet.

lines.zh: 兔子蹬了我一脚，爪子挺利。
lines.en: The rabbit kicks me once; its claws are sharp.

lines.zh: 完事我叼着它，往你脚边放。
lines.en: Done, I carry it over and lay it at your feet.

lines.zh: 这是给你的，我吃不了这么多。
lines.en: This one is for you; I cannot eat it all.

lines.zh: 我攻击很短，一击就退开。
lines.en: My attack is short; one strike and I back off.

lines.zh: 我从一段倒木底下钻出来。
lines.en: I come out from under a fallen log.

lines.zh: 这是平原边的林子，草很高。
lines.en: This is the woodland edge of the plains, tall grass.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身上的木屑。
lines.en: I shake the wood dust from my coat.

lines.zh: 空气里有兔子的味道，我饿了。
lines.en: The air smells of rabbit, and I am hungry.

lines.zh: 先找一处能藏身的树根。
lines.en: First, find tree roots that will hide me.

lines.zh: 我把洞口选在两块石头中间。
lines.en: I pick a burrow mouth between two stones.

lines.zh: 这片林子兔子多，适合我住。
lines.en: This wood has many rabbits; it suits me.

lines.zh: 天亮不久，我还有很多时间。
lines.en: Dawn is young; I have plenty of time.

lines.zh: 我沿着篱笆走，先认认地界。
lines.en: I walk the fence line to learn the boundaries.

lines.zh: 有人的气味，不过还不算近。
lines.en: There is a human scent, but not yet close.

lines.zh: 火星落到背上，毛焦了一小片。
lines.en: A spark lands on my back and singes my fur.

lines.zh: 从树杈上摔下来，我落地就滚。
lines.en: I fall from a branch and roll as I hit ground.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我拼命往岸上扒。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I claw desperately for the bank.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀进灌木，耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast throws me into a bush, my ears ringing.

lines.zh: 箭擦过肋侧，带走一撮白毛。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my ribs and takes a tuft of fur.

lines.zh: 紫色的光缠住我，我动不了了。
lines.en: Violet light winds around me and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 两天没抓到兔子，我肚子贴背。
lines.en: Two days without a rabbit; my belly touches my spine.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我整条身子都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree and numbness runs through me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我的爪子空刨。
lines.en: No earth in the void; my paws dig at nothing.
